✨ codeburn | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide developers with clear visibility and control over their AI coding tool token consumption and associated costs.
✨ Key Features: • Tracks AI coding token usage and cost • Supports 37 AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini) • Provides breakdowns by model, project, and task • Offers both a CLI and a menubar/web dashboard interface • Local and free to use
📖 Summary: CodeBurn is a free, local tool designed to track AI coding token usage and associated costs across numerous AI tools and agents. It provides detailed breakdowns by model, project, and task, offering visibility into AI spending.
